description: Source code for CRM module in OpenERP/Odoo, defining classes and methods for handling cases, sections, categories, rules, logs, and histories.

classes.name: crm_case_section
classes.description: Represents sections of cases, with hierarchy and menu creation methods.

classes.name: crm_case_categ
classes.description: Represents categories of cases with probability and section association.

classes.name: crm_case_rule
classes.description: Defines rules for automating case actions based on triggers and conditions.

classes.name: crm_case
classes.description: Main class for managing individual cases, including creation, updates, status changes, and email communication.

classes.name: crm_case_log
classes.description: Logs communication and actions related to cases.

classes.name: crm_case_history
classes.description: Tracks history of case actions, inherits from crm_case_log.

methods.name: _action
methods.description: Executes rules on cases to change status, assign responsible users, send emails, and trigger reminders based on conditions.

methods.name: format_mail
methods.description: Prepares email content by formatting case data into a template.

methods.name: email_send
methods.description: Sends email notifications related to cases.

methods.name: remind_user
methods.description: Sends reminder email to responsible user.

methods.name: case_close
methods.description: Marks a case as closed and logs the action.

methods.name: case_escalate
methods.description: Escalates a case to a higher section or responsible user.

methods.name: case_open
methods.description: Reopens a case and logs the action.

methods.name: case_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a case and logs the action.

methods.name: case_pending
methods.description: Marks a case as pending and logs the action.

methods.name: case_reset
methods.description: Resets a case to draft state.
